findings.finding: CVXOPT stacking omits the relative n/(n-1) normalization of the derivative term.
findings.resolution: Use the textbook/CVX normalization with n=201, derivative divisor 200; all three prescribed cases executed and checked against an independent QP.

findings.finding: Three distinct sample conventions: book prose interval [0,1] with printed 0.005k, CVX k/500 with Gaussian-tail truncation, CVXOPT k/501 without truncation.
